name: Shell
description: The wise warriors know that to outlast the opponent is all that victory demands. Be the immovable shore.

abilities.name: Glancing Blows
abilities.description: When parrying, if attack still risks damage, Soak dice treat 4s as successes.

abilities.name: Watchful Eye
abilities.description: First attack of opportunity each round costs no Stamina.

abilities.name: Withstand
abilities.description: When taking damage, gain +1 Soak die against further damage that round.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.description: When Focusing, Shell increases by Soul Focused (min 1) until next turn. When Focusing Soul to heal, may restore armor Durability.

abilities.name: Impassible
abilities.description: Adjacent squares are rough terrain for foes (2 Speed/Footwork cost). Flying/Leaping bugs are forced to land.

abilities.name: Martial Defense
abilities.description: May use Normal Weapon Arts as attacks of opportunity, or activate Augmentation Art during attack of opportunity.
